title: The Night Inventory
concept: A stock clerk counts mannequins in a closed department store every night. Tonight there is one more than the inventory sheet.
conflict: The count must match or he can't clock out.
escalation: Each recount, the extra mannequin is closer to the stockroom where Dev stands.
reveal: The sheet isn't wrong. Last night's clerk is listed as a mannequin.
ending: Dev's own name is printed on tomorrow's inventory sheet.
emotional_objective: Escalating recount tension; mundane job horror.

hooks.line: There are 41 mannequins in this store. Tonight I counted 42.
My night job has one rule: the count has to match.
The extra mannequin is wearing the last night clerk's badge.
Which one of these wasn't here yesterday?
hooks.first_visual: Line-up of mannequins, one slightly turned.

originality_review: Mannequin horror is common; the inventory-count mechanic and reveal are original. Check similarity against competitor mannequin stories before scripting.
